messages:
jia: FYI ran the int8 quantized bring-up for rwd-licious-1 (new opt kernels). Quick regression: JP ellipsis '...' being collapsed/preserved incorrectly, and Arabic diacritics removed in some translations. Examples below :eyes:

jia: Source: "今日は... まだ終わっていない。" (JP)
jia: Model output (int8): "今日は まだ終わっていない。"  <-- ellipsis removed
jia: FP16 output: "今日は... まだ終わっていない。"  ok

jia: Arabic example src: "الطلابُ قرأواُ الكتابَ." (with diacritics)
jia: int8 output: "الطلاب قرأوا الكتاب."  (diacritics stripped)

jia: Tokenizer diffs:
```python
toks_fp16 = tokenizer.encode("今日は... まだ終わっていない。", add_special_tokens=False)
toks_int8 = tokenizer_int8.encode("今日は... まだ終わっていない。", add_special_tokens=False)
print(toks_fp16)
print(toks_int8)
# fp16: [..., 3421, 17, 3421, ...]
# int8: [..., 3421, 17, 3522, ...]  # note different subtoken at ellipsis
```

omar: Interesting — looks like vocabulary merging changed during quant conversion? Did we run tokenizer merge check? :thinking_face:

maya: Could be detokenization rule mismatch. Are we using the same tokenizer.json across variants?

jia: I rechecked — same tokenizer files, but runtime kernel picks fallback path that reuses older BPE merges for short repeated punctuation. Suspect post-quant stable-hashing bug.

eval-bot: CI-evals/1871234567 completed — overall BLEU -1.8 on ja->en, chrF -0.03, Arabic diacritic F1 -0.72 :warning:

nina: Can you paste a minimal repro? I can run local tokenizer diff harness.

jia: Minimal repro attached below:
```bash
python tools/tokenizer_diff.py --left model_fp16/tokenizer.json --right model_int8/tokenizer.json \  --input "今日は... まだ終わっていない。"
```

sam: If this only affects punctuation and diacritics, maybe we can A/B route int8 for non-CJK locales and keep fp16 for ja/ar until fix. Cost impact estimate?

maya: A/B is fine short term. Need perf delta numbers — int8 saves ~28% token-cost but increases ja->en error.

omar: Also run quant-aware tokenizer hashing test I pushed yesterday. It caught similar off-by-one subtoken in another run.

jia: Plan: 1) run tokenizer-hash test across all quant variants 2) add targeted unit tests for ellipses + Arabic tashkeel 3) temp route non-CJK/RTL to fp16. I'll open ticket and can patch quant pipeline.

sam: Thanks. Please add evaluation artifacts to the ticket (diffs + failing examples). :thumbsup:

jia: Will do. Opening ticket now. 1871234#issue

maya: ping me when ticket's up, I'll schedule canary routing.

omar: Thanks for catching this early.
